subject: plotting spaghetti plots from growth mixture model

messages.author: e3baa8d88c523ecb
messages.subject: plotting spaghetti plots from growth mixture model
parts:
Hi,
I'm new to MplusAutomation. I've run a growth mixture model using Mplus, but I would like to plot my data using R. Is it possible to use MplusAutomation to do this - I'm specifically interested in plotting the spaghetti plots with the entire sample (not just the means from each class). 
Thanks! Lauren

messages.author: d1476638f44e4cd8
messages.subject: Re: plotting spaghetti plots from growth mixture model
parts:
Hi, Here is some code for making spaghetti plots with R/MplusAutomation:
https://garberadamc.github.io/project-site/Lab6-growth-models

The functions in the script from the Mplus website are needed for this (mplus.R):
 https://www.statmodel.com/mplus-R/mplus.R
